title: Marvell Semiconductor President and CEO Matt Murphy Elected Chair of SIA
主要内容: The Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA) announced on 2017-11-14 that Matt Murphy, President and CEO of Marvell Semiconductor, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL), has been elected as its 2018 Chair. Sanjay Mehrotra, President and CEO of Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MU), was elected as 2018 Vice Chair. Murphy has led Marvell since joining the company in July 2016, overseeing its turnaround and reestablishing it as a leading innovator in storage and networking technology. Mehrotra, with over two decades at Maxim Integrated, brings extensive experience in semiconductor technology leadership. Murphy emphasized the importance of semiconductor technology in shaping the modern world and called for increased U.S. support for research, competitiveness, and global trade.
